reviews.text:
The staff are kind, patient and courteous. They show care for the animals as well as pet parents. Dr White is knowledgeable but does not push unnecessary tests, services or medication. He answers your questions and will consult with the best interest of your fur baby as a priority. We have four doggos who all go to Harbor Pines.
Susan Carrion
Anthony at the front desk is very courteous and efficient.
Great service you guys did a great job but you charge way too much money

It’s always a positive experience going to this vet. I’ve been using them since they first opened years ago. I’ve used all the doctors and they all seem to be great. The front desk staff is really helpful and I would recommend them to anyone.

We have been with Dr. White at Harbor Pines for 5 years now and they are the best around. Dr. White has taken care of our "babies" with the best care we can hope for and the staff have always been so helpful and so nice.

I was originally recommended this Vet by a colleague of mine. She spoke nothing but great things about this place and since I had just rescued my dog I thought “Hey, if the prices are good AND they truly care about your animal why not?” I have been bringing my dog here for a year now and they are nothing but the most amazing people and doctors I have met. They are always so nice and caring it blows my mind. My dog doesnt get nervous but excited to see them and I truly see how much they care and helpful they are. I will be bringing Gizmo here for as long as he lives.

Always a good experience at Harbor Pines! We love Dr White, however when we are not able to see him we know we are still in good hands with the other doctors and staff onsite. They are so good with our dogs, treating them with care and being most considerate, just like extended family! Front office staff are the BEST!

Updated Review: I recently left a negative review simply because I could not reach the office to make an appointment. I've never had the business owner call me an apologize. My review had nothing to do with the office itself but the fact I couldn't even reach them. I just got off the phone with Dr White and I gotta say I respect him reaching out and so quickly implementing some changes.

original review: Had a great initial experience, unfortunately I've had so much trouble just getting a hold of someone. I am immediately getting placed on lengthy holds 15min+ no matter when I call. I've tried multiple times to schedule an appointment and after calling so many times with the same result I've gone back to my former vet. Too bad because I liked them. Customer service is everything and being able to call and speak to someone in a reasonable amount of time to place an appointment should not be this difficult.

It takes weeks to get my vet's medication filled. I have literally called 7 times since Friday, and it's the following Wed. When you call you automatically get placed on hold with music. I have wait as long as 17min on hold before hanging up just to follow up with my dog's prescription.

Wow, everyone was a delight!
The Vets techs were great and especially the gal ( sorry I forgot her name), who drew blood was outstanding!! Thank you so much Dr White for caring and taking time to patiently explain important details to me. I appreciate it!

I have three pets and all go to Harbor Pines Veterinary, Dr Ghajari and Dr White are outstanding. They’re good with my animals; gentle and kind. They listen in my concerns and questions and work collaboratively with me to come up with solutions that best work for my family and my pets. I can’t say enough about what a great office this is. Also the front desk Staff are outstanding. Most front desk, staff at veterinary office are jaded and burnt out. Not at Harbor Pines. They always have a smile on their face and are helpful despite the animal chaos going on around them.

My senior cat had not been eating but had been vomiting for a few days. I recalled reading positive comments about Harbor Pines Veterinary's practice a few years ago so I decided to give them a try. I'm so glad I did! Everyone I came in contact with was  knowledgeable, personable and very helpful. Thanks to Debbie on the front desk I was able to schedule a same day weekend appointment. I'm looking forward to dealing with Harbor Pines for my future veterinary needs. Thank you all!
Excellent customer service, friendly staff, and most of all they love our pets like they are their pets!

We are so grateful for Harbor Pines Veterinary Center, especially Dr White. The team took us in quickly and treated our dog with genuine care and compassion. Dr White took the time to explain everything clearly, answered all of our questions, and made sure we understood the treatment plan so we could help our dog recover comfortably at home.

You can tell the entire staff truly cares about animals and their families. The clinic is professional, welcoming, and they go above and beyond to make a stressful situation feel manageable.

If you are looking for a vet who is knowledgeable, patient, and truly dedicated to your pet’s wellbeing, we highly recommend Harbor Pines Veterinary Center and Dr White. We are incredibly thankful for the care they provided to our girl!
They take amazing care of my pets. Small to huge issues this place has always helped my animals!
Dr.white and his assistant Maddie were amazing!
Love the vet, they are always friendly and the prices are reasonable!
Dr.White and his staff always attends to my pets needs with a since of urgency and with a great attention to detail.
Steve was really great with my doggy Harley. He went in to get checked for de worming. He was quick and very informative . Harley was comfortable going to the back with Steve for his check up.

I walked and stood at the front counter looking to engage in new business.  No one acknowledged me. There were 2 staff members up front and another outside on the phone on a personal call. I walked out to go get my food from next door. I called to tell the receptionist that I was there but no one would give me the time of day.  She didn't apologize just said ok ill forward this to management. So I looked on the website for an email or a contact information for management. I didn't see anything, but maybe this will get to them.

Dr. White is the best vet in town hands down. He has cured my cats of simple illnesses to major surgeries. He is knowledgeable and listens to his patients. He’s is also honest and cares for all animals.  He’s the best!

Dr White goes out of his way to ensure my dogs and cats are well taken care of.  He also will sit and explain my pets’ medical issues.  The front office staff are the best.  Always on top of things.  Thank you Dr White and Harbor Pines Veterinary Center!

Spoke with Debbie this morning.  She very helpful changing our cat's appt from tomorrow to today. Dr. White is always so pleasant and takes time to explain everything. Our cat is doing very well with Dr's plan, medications and diet change.
Everyone from front desk to techs and of course Dr Danash were so Great. I love this office.

I took my Boots here when he was having breathing issues. The front office vet assistants were very nice. He was seen by Dr Gahjari, he was very sympathetic, he explained everything to me in terms I could understand. I felt cared for here. Once my cats lab work came back Dr White called and also talked and explained his diagnosis in a way I could understand. Eventually I had to let my Boots go. They took care of everything showed so much compassion. They even sent a sympathy card. Thank you for taking care of my Boots and me.
Wonderful service and compassionate attention.Dr. White is so caring and Anthony at the front desk is so friendly and efficient.
